info.title: Biomedical Research Navigator API
info.summary: Workspace-oriented clinical and assay exploration API.
info.description: Biomedical Research Navigator exposes a browser-facing API for multi-dataset workspace selection, clinical query and analysis, saved cohorts, and Pheno-Ranker execution over sample-level data.

get.description: Serves the Biomedical Research Navigator HTML shell with the current branding and authenticated user context.
Returns patient-level summaries for the active dataset or workspace scope.
Returns the normalized clinical context for a single patient identifier.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Patients  Patient Id  Get

get.description: Returns the timeline-oriented patient workspace payload used by the patient detail view.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Workspace Patients  Patient Id  Workspace Get

get.description: Returns medication counts derived from the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Get Medication Counts Cohorts Medications Get

get.description: Returns disease counts derived from the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Get Disease Counts Cohorts Diseases Get

get.description: Returns the deterministic medication-matched workspace subset for a single medication label.

schema.title: Response Search Medication Cohort Cohorts Medications Search Get

get.summary: Run a simple GET workspace query
get.description: Executes a lightweight workspace query using query-string parameters. Prefer POST /query for full prompt history and planner mode control.

post.description: Executes a deterministic and/or LLM-assisted natural-language query against the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Query App Post Query Post

get.description: Returns whether LM Studio is enabled plus the current model and base URL.
Admin-only registry and health view for approved OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints.

schema.title: Response Get Lm Providers Lm Providers Get

get.description: Returns the current local-auth session state and visible user identity.
Redirects to the configured OIDC provider when BRN_AUTH_MODE=oidc.

post.description: Authenticates a local user and creates a session-backed login.

get.description: Handles the OIDC authorization-code callback and maps the external identity to a local Biomedical Research Navigator user.

post.description: Clears the local session for the current user.
Sends a password reset email when SMTP-backed local reset is configured. The response does not reveal whether the account exists.
Consumes a password reset token and replaces the local password.

get.description: Returns local-auth diagnostics useful during development and deployment troubleshooting.
Returns local users and groups. When auth is enabled, this endpoint is admin-only.

post.description: Creates a persisted local user with application role and groups. Admin-only when auth is enabled.

patch.description: Updates display name, role, groups, or enabled state for a local user. Admin-only when auth is enabled.

delete.description: Deletes a persisted local user. Admin-only when auth is enabled.

post.description: Replaces the password for a local user. Admin-only when auth is enabled.

get.description: Returns persisted UI preferences for the current user.

patch.description: Persists UI preferences for the current user.

get.description: Returns datasets visible to the current user plus the currently active workspace selection.

post.description: Creates a new dataset registry entry. Admin-only.
Applies one or more authorized dataset IDs as the current workspace for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates dataset metadata, visibility, or access policy. Admin-only.

post.description: Builds or rebuilds the admin-managed DuckDB store for one dataset. Admin-only.

get.description: Returns the current instance branding logo file if one is configured.
Returns saved cohorts for the current user within the active dataset workspace.

post.description: Persists a saved cohort containing canonical sample IDs and derived patient IDs.

delete.description: Deletes a saved cohort owned by the current user.
Deletes all saved analysis chats owned by the current user.

schema.title: Response Delete User Analysis Sessions User Data Analysis Sessions Delete

delete.description: Deletes terminal background jobs and generated artifacts owned by the current user. Active jobs are skipped.

schema.title: Response Delete User Completed Jobs User Data Jobs Delete

delete.description: Deletes saved cohorts owned by the current user when they are not referenced by saved analysis chats.

schema.title: Response Delete User Saved Cohorts User Data Saved Cohorts Delete

get.description: Returns curated analysis definitions plus computed availability for the current workspace.

schema.title: Response Get Analysis Catalog Analysis Catalog Get

post.description: Executes clinical or assay analysis over the active workspace or selected saved cohorts.

get.description: Returns recent background jobs visible to the current user across supported product surfaces.
Returns detailed status plus the completed payload for one background job visible to the current user.

schema.title: Response Get Job Jobs  Job Id  Get

delete.description: Deletes one completed, failed, or cancelled job and its generated artifacts for the current user.

get.description: Returns one persisted artifact for a background job visible to the current user.
Returns all generated analysis and Pheno-Ranker runs visible to the current user.

schema.title: Response Get Run History Run History Get

delete.description: Deletes completed, failed, or cancelled generated runs and artifacts owned by the current user. Active runs are skipped.
Deletes one completed, failed, or cancelled generated run and its artifacts for the current user.

get.description: Returns assay datasets visible in the current workspace.
Returns workspace-level multimodal coverage, overlap, linkage issues, and deterministic next-step suggestions.
Returns gene identifiers for a selected assay with optional search and limit filtering.

schema.title: Response Get Assay Features Assays Features Get

post.description: Returns scoped gene expression summaries for one assay, optionally comparing cohort A and cohort B.

schema.title: Response Get Assay Expression Assays Expression Post

get.description: Returns DICOM studies configured for the current workspace with OHIF launch URLs.
Returns DICOM/OHIF/Orthanc configuration status for the current workspace.
Returns persisted analysis sessions for the current user.

schema.title: Response Get Analysis Sessions Analysis Sessions Get

post.summary: Create or update an analysis session
post.description: Persists analysis session state, including prompt draft, scopes, and prior turns.

schema.title: Response Create Or Update Analysis Session Analysis Sessions Post

patch.description: Updates the title of a saved analysis session.

schema.title: Response Update Analysis Session Title Analysis Sessions  Session Id  Patch

delete.description: Deletes a saved analysis session for the current user.

post.description: Runs Pheno-Ranker for the active workspace using either patient mode or cohort mode.

schema.title: Response Get Pheno Ranker Patient Ids Pheno Ranker Patient Ids Get

get.summary: Explain Pheno-Ranker results with the LLM
get.description: Builds an LLM-assisted explanation from the top ranked Pheno-Ranker matches.
